children: France’s overall business climate fell to 96 in September 2026 from 98 in the previous month and moving further below its long-term average of 100.
The decline was driven mainly by retail trade, where the indicator dropped five points to 94, as order intentions, the overall business outlook and past sales assessments weakened.

The services climate also edged down to 98 from 99, with demand, activity and expected staffing balances declining, while wholesale trade fell two points to 93 as past export sales and order intentions weakened.
Meanwhile, the business climate in industry remained stable at 101, slightly above its long-term average, with stronger past and expected production offsetting weaker overall order books.
Construction was also unchanged at 96, as improved views of past activity offset weaker business outlooks.
The employment climate fell one point to 98.

title: France Business Climate Deteriorates in September
